name: job_id
description: Unique identifier (UUID) for this processing attempt.

name: job_name
description: Logical job name: <contract>_load, or 'unmapped' when no contract matched.

name: trigger_type
description: What triggered the run (PUBSUB, MANUAL).

name: pubsub_message_id
description: Pub/Sub message ID that triggered the run.

name: pubsub_subscription
description: Pub/Sub subscription that delivered the message.

name: delivery_attempt
description: Pub/Sub delivery attempt from the push envelope (when available).

name: attempt_number
description: Attempt count for this object generation (1 = first attempt).

name: is_retried
description: Whether this run is a retry of a previous attempt for the same object generation.

name: status
description: IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, REJECTED, FAILED, DUPLICATE_SKIPPED.

name: status_reason
description: Short human-readable reason for the status.

name: start_time
description: Processing start time.

name: end_time
description: Processing end time.

name: duration_seconds
description: Wall-clock processing duration in seconds.

name: source_bucket
description: GCS bucket the file landed in.

name: file_name
description: Object name of the landed file.

name: file_path
description: gs:// URI of the landed file.

name: file_generation
description: GCS object generation; part of the idempotency key.

name: file_size_bytes
description: Size of the landed file in bytes.

name: file_format
description: File format (csv, xlsx).

name: file_date
description: Business date parsed from the file name.

name: file_created_at
description: GCS object creation time.

name: staged_file_path
description: gs:// URI of the enriched CSV in staging used for the load.

name: final_file_path
description: gs:// URI the original file was moved to (archive or invalid).

name: contract_name
description: Data contract applied.

name: contract_version
description: Version of the data contract applied.

name: target_table
description: Fully-qualified target table (project.dataset.table).

name: load_mode
description: Load mode from the contract (append, overwrite).

name: bq_load_job_id
description: BigQuery load job ID.

name: rows_in_file
description: Number of data rows in the file (excluding header).

name: rows_loaded
description: Rows loaded into the target, from the load job output_rows.

name: rows_failed_validation
description: Distinct rows failing at least one ERROR-severity rule.

name: validation_status
description: Overall validation outcome (PASSED, FAILED).

name: validation_rules_executed
description: Number of validation rules executed.

name: validation_rules_failed
description: Number of validation rules that failed (any severity).

name: recon_status
description: Post-load reconciliation outcome (PASSED, FAILED, SKIPPED).

name: error_code
description: Machine-readable error code.

name: error_message
description: Short error message.

name: error_details
description: Structured error details (exception type, traceback excerpt).

name: gcp_project
description: GCP project the service ran in.

name: gcp_region
description: GCP region the service ran in.

name: service_name
description: Cloud Run service name (K_SERVICE).

name: service_revision
description: Cloud Run revision (K_REVISION).

name: service_version
description: Application version of the file processor.

name: created_by
description: Identity (service account) that executed the run.

name: custom_labels
description: Arbitrary key/value labels attached to this run.

name: created_at
description: Timestamp this record was created.

name: updated_at
description: Timestamp this record was last updated.
